changes.title: Separate local trading desk
changes.before: A long static public blotter with tabs and retained source records.
changes.after: Daily Desk, Evidence, Trade journal, Bot Operations and Changes views in a separate local dashboard.

changes.title: Eight original resources preserved
changes.before: Data and context spread across seven published HTML pages and Peanut news JSON.
changes.after: Allowlisted manual import retains the original source files and normalized provenance; Chart and Map data already present in production are carried forward.

changes.title: Distinct evidence clocks
changes.before: Page-build, mark-refresh and market-observation dates can appear beside a retained LIVE session badge.
changes.after: Collection time, page build, marks, macro judgment and completed chart session are shown independently. Imported snapshots are not advertised as live market feeds.

changes.title: Ticker evidence and filters
changes.before: Watches, technical observations, events, news and claims require moving between large tables.
changes.after: Ticker drilldowns and search/filter controls organize the imported evidence with source links and original fields.

changes.title: Reported performance scope made explicit
changes.before: Reported closed-ticket P&L and header day/week figures have different scopes.
changes.after: Trade journal uses reported paper-ledger rows and explicit denominators; unavailable account NAV, cash flows and verified settlement remain unavailable.

changes.title: Persistent paper review notes
changes.before: The static site cannot store a local review note or review state through an application API.
changes.after: Append-only SQLite review records support reviewed, needs-review and hold statuses on imported trade/evidence rows, bind notes to the inspected snapshot and preserve retry identity without authorizing execution.

changes.title: Local API and change notifications
changes.before: Browser refresh reloads static publication; Peanut JSON is the only published JSON request identified in inspected HTML.
changes.after: A local snapshot API, CSV export, manual public-source sync and SSE for local snapshot/review changes support the new interface.

changes.title: Current versus proposed bot operation
changes.before: Production cadences, missing writers and soft mandates coexist with a newer five-role design.
changes.after: Bot Operations distinguishes reported production state from proposed sources/cadence and exposes the actual copied Rose, Hal, Macro, Chart and News prompts.

changes.title: Visible production limitations
changes.before: Flat-book warning, quota-panel conflict, older calendar, unbuilt feeds and empty supplier graph can be misread.
changes.after: Audit notes explain these findings while retaining source values and provenance. No predictions, supplier edges, account returns or market connectivity are invented.

changes.title: Live collector and brokerage integration
changes.before: Private production collectors and receiving daemons are unavailable in this project.
changes.after: Manual public-snapshot synchronization is available by design; licensed live feeds, collector deployment and bot push receivers remain outside this local build.

changes.title: Chart cadence: weekday collector
changes.before: Audit and Bot Operations text described Chart as a one-shot daily history with no weekday collector.
changes.after: Chart Bot refreshes Robinhood daily bars for the 37-name Tech∪chip play on weekdays at about 2:24 PM PT; weekends and holidays keep the last completed session. Intraday/weekly bars, 1-min RVOL, patterns, SOXX and forecasts remain N/A. Preserved raw snapshot text is unchanged.

changes.title: Durable box copy aligned to live production
changes.before: Project lived only as a tmp unzip with Mac paths; production-vs-proposed status, API ownership and duplicate vendor queries were not recorded together.
changes.after: Copied to /workspace/oid-trading-desk with SETUP-VS-PRODUCTION, API-INVENTORY, QUERY-ARCHITECTURE (mermaid, owner/reader split, RH watch-quote duplicate, FA Growth shared limit, single X pool, archive path), HANDBOOK-ERRATA and data/live-bridge.md. No collectors installed, no quota used, no orders.

changes.title: Rose sole writer of rh-quotes
changes.before: Hal hal-rh-watch at :05/:35 ET and Rose's live book pulse both called Robinhood get_equity_quotes for the Tech∪chip union. The overlap was open debt.
changes.after: Jeffrey + Rose agreed Rose (dashboard/refresh_marks.py) is the sole writer of market-data/latest/rh-quotes.json (owner rose, TTL 120s, 38 Tech∪chip+index symbols). Hal reads that file for soft tape and annotates Soft A only. No get_equity_quotes for the union while the file is fresh. Elevate/invalidate still uses live Robinhood ≤120s, never the cache. No collector cutover.

changes.title: Cutover plus rh-quotes piggyback
changes.before: Support-map and market-tape could re-quote names Rose had already written. The box tree and this GitHub repo were separate, and Architecture/Setup were not in the repo rebuild.
changes.after: Production root is /workspace/oid-trading-desk with options-intelligence-desk as a symlink. Rose refresh_marks.py stays the sole rh-quotes writer. Tape and support-map call piggyback_rh_quotes and never write that file. live_refresh is tape cache-first. Architecture and Setup nav rebuild locally. No vendor payloads, supply-chain.db, secrets, tmp backups, or the live paper ledger are in the PR. Research/paper only. Zero brokerage execution.
